lighting.light_consistency_qa: Each subject must be legible in grayscale with plausible source, fill, rim, atmosphere; typography overlays deterministic; actual full-resolution generated-image QA required.

image_generation_policy.background: canon-safe cinematic scenes and motivated lighting
image_generation_policy.forbidden_in_generated_raster: No generated team names, record numbers, source percentages or readable copy
image_generation_policy.exact_overlay: Separate deterministic typography pass after rendering
image_generation_policy.must_preserve_identity: each canonical character crop SHA and Atlas structural plate

overlays.narrative_body: The stronghold hears the scrape of stone beneath D0nkey K0ng's four planted legs. His Majesty's Blood approaches, but the more exact challenge waits beyond: ObiWan in Week 12 and Snake in Week 13. Defeat both and the Burgers crown is his under the retained rules, regardless of the other games. He looks toward those two roads, not the balcony crowd. Control is only useful when exercised.
overlays.math_scope_note: Still alive after a Week 11 loss; no berth clinched at Week 10.

lighting.key: warm low sun across gorilla-centaur four-legged form

overlays.narrative_headline: The Belt Is Not the Gate
overlays.narrative_body: Under a hood and beneath the iron of his keep, His Majesty's Blood guards the Belt already earned. The postseason, however, has offered him no such possession. D0nkey K0ng comes first, then all three remaining Pizza opponents. Three more victories would guarantee a berth. He tightens the black armor at his wrist and advances through the keep's cold light. A champion's trinket cannot win tomorrow's encounter.
overlays.math_scope_note: Still alive after a Week 11 loss; no berth clinched at Week 10.
